visualCharacteristics.description: Image-only photo mosaic within the content column with tight ~6px gutters, no borders/card bodies, mixed tile proportions (row 1: wide + 2 narrow; row 2: 2 tall portraits). Each image opens a lightbox in the source.

contentPattern.structure: one row per photo: [image] | [optional caption, usually empty]; tiles repeat in groups of five (wide + 2 narrow, then 2 tall)
